title: Fusion or Confusion? Multimodal Complexity Is Not All You Need
abstract: arXiv:2512.22991v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal learning has become a prominent research area, with the potential of substantial performance gains by combining information across modalities. At the same time, model development has trended toward increasingly complex deep learning architectures, motivated by the assumption that multimodal-specific methods improve performance. We challenge this assumption through a large-scale empirical study by reimplementing 19 high-impact multimodal methods across nine diverse datasets with up to 23 modalities. Under standardized experimental conditions, including hyperparameter tuning, weight initialization, cross-validation, and statistical testing, increased multimodal complexity often yields confusion rather than effective fusion of data modalities. translated_title: 融合还是混淆？多模态复杂性并非万能
translated_abstract: 多模态学习已成为一个重要的研究领域，通过跨模态信息的组合有望带来显著的性能提升。与此同时，模型开发正趋向于日益复杂的深度学习架构，其背后的假设是多模态专用方法能够提升性能。我们通过一项大规模实证研究对这一假设提出了挑战：在九个多样化的数据集（最多包含23种模态）上重新实现了19个高影响力的多模态方法。在包括超参数调优、权重初始化、交叉验证和统计检验在内的标准化实验条件下，多模态复杂性的增加往往带来的是混淆而非数据模态的有效融合。因此，复杂的多模态架构并不能稳定地超越单模态基线和面向多模态学习的简单基线。通过一项聚焦的案例研究，我们进一步……
tldr: 该论文通过大规模实证研究（重新实现19个多模态方法、覆盖9个数据集最多23种模态）发现，在标准化实验条件下，多模态复杂性的增加往往导致混淆而非有效融合，复杂多模态架构并不能稳定超越单模态基线，并据此提出了面向多模态学习的简单基线方法SimBaMM。
en_tdlr: A large-scale empirical study reimplementing 19 high-impact multimodal methods across nine datasets shows that increased multimodal complexity often yields confusion rather than effective fusion, with complex architectures failing to reliably outperform unimodal baselines, motivating a proposed Simple Baseline for Multimodal Learning (SimBaMM).
